name: RibFrac (MICCAI 2020) chest CT
what: 660 chest CT volumes with rib fracture labels, and the RibSeg v2 and Moller rib masks
level_truth: none for the vertebrae; the thoracic spine is in view

segmentations.masks: rib masks of RibSeg v2, corrected by experts, and Moller's rib masks
segmentations.by: RibSeg v2's experts; Moller's, by hand and automatic

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together; the folder holds this set and RSNA 2022's cervical spine together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (RibFrac); the Moller masks CC BY 4.0
how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/ribfrac, downloaded from Zenodo, 2026-09-19 to 2026-09-23; nothing to fetch.
To share it with collaborators, copy it into /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/ribfrac/ with its checksums as a Slurm job, as the pig set of #22 was copied, and note the job in the history.
record: SchwingNet data/sources/ctspine1k_ctpelvic1k_ribfrac.json, split into its three sets, 2026-10-23
source_status: held on the grid under the owner's data root, as SchwingNet's registry records it on 2026-10-23
